text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A very tired-looking Vodka comes walking toward me.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Sigh… What was up with that dream last night?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I was so excited to be surrounded by all those stuffed animals…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Do I subconsciously wish I had a cute room like that?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Sigh… That was not a fun way to wake up. I feel exhausted…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Can we go light on the training today?
